messages:
maya: Hey team — quick follow-up from the design sync. I pushed a compact "pool matrix" mock that groups GPU pools by latency tier and shows burst quanta inline. Screenshot: https://cloud.redwood/mock/pool-matrix-v2.png

sam: Nice! Can you paste the mock here? I can’t access the link from home.

maya: pasted below — main differences: 1) matrix vs list view 2) burst displayed as small pills with unit (e.g., +2 GPU) 3) SLO slider moved to the header (global) instead of per-row

kevin: quick reaction: matrix helps for comparison but worried about keyboard nav and focus order. If header has SLO slider, where does focus go when tabbing through rows?

anna: accessibility nit: color alone is used to show pool health. Need visible text/state and an aria-live update for dynamic changes. Also add aria-label for the burst pill: e.g., `aria-label="Burst: adds 2 GPUs for 15m"`.

jordan: copy suggestion for the burst legend: current "Burst" is ambiguous. How about: "Temporary burst (adds GPUs for short bursts; billed while active)". Short label for tooltip: "Temporary capacity".

maya: @kevin good call — proposed focus order: header controls -> pool row (row-level action group) -> burst pill -> pool selector menu. We can add a skip link: "Skip to pool list" for screen readers. Thoughts?

sam: I like skip link idea. Also: when burst is disabled, hide the pill but keep an affordance `Add burst` with role=button so it's reachable.

kevin: keyboard flow looks fine but pair with a focus ring that’s >= 3px and high contrast. Use `outline-offset` for overlapping pills. Also ensure arrow-key navigation in matrix moves logically (right -> next pool in same latency bucket, down -> next latency bucket).

anna: another a11y note: SLO slider needs discrete steps and visible tick marks. Right now the mock snaps but no ticks — screen reader users won’t know allowed values. Add `aria-valuetext` that reads current SLO and expected impact (e.g., "SLO: 99.5% — may increase cost by ~12%" ).

jordan: UX question: moving SLO slider to header makes it global — do we need per-pool overrides? Product wanted both global target + per-pool minimums. Maybe header SLO with a small per-row lock icon that indicates "follow global SLO" vs "override".

maya: product: global SLO by default, per-pool override via ellipsis menu -> "Override SLO" opens a tiny inline control. Lock icon copy: tooltip "Uses global target" / "Overridden".

sam: Can we show cost delta in-line when making overrides? Tiny inline badge: "+3.4% cost" next to override. Need microcopy: "Est. cost change" for tooltip.

kevin: performance/visual: re ordering to matrix adds density — make sure we have at least 12px between interactive elements for touch. Also provide a compact mode toggle in accessibility settings.

anna: microcopy tweak for burst confirmation modal: instead of "Start burst?" use "Confirm temporary capacity" and include duration and estimated cost. Screen reader should announce changes: `aria-live="assertive"` when burst starts/stops.

jordan: design question: legend placement. If matrix is big, legend in the top-right floats — but on small view it should collapse into a single-line summary: "3 pools healthy • 1 degraded" that expands.

maya: good call — responsive legend: summary + expandable details. Also changed the burst pill color from bright red to amber to avoid alarm semantics. Match token-level cost color palette (amber for higher cost, red for down).

sam: UX nit: pool reorder affordance — currently drag handle is tiny. Make whole row draggable area in dense view and provide a keyboard reorder widget using `aria-grabbed`.

kevin: agree. Also include an animation preference: reduce motion for users with `prefers-reduced-motion`. Complex reorders should be instantaneous for that setting.

anna: accessibility checklist request: can we add a short checklist to the mock annotations? Items: focus order, labels, live regions, reduced motion, keyboard reorder, visible states.

maya: will add checklist + updated copy and push new PNG. Plan: 1) update mock with header SLO + per-row override icon 2) add aria examples in annotation comments 3) change legend responsive behavior 4) update burst microcopy and confirmation modal 5) add keyboard reorder example

jordan: timeline? I can help with cost delta copy and tooltip strings.

maya: aiming to push v2 by EOD tomorrow. @jordan assign to you for copy review. @kevin and @anna can you pair on the a11y checklist?

design-bot: Reminder: design review requested — prototype link: https://figma.redwood/pool-matrix-v2 — review due in 24h.

sam: thanks — leaving a couple inline comments in Figma.

kevin: will start testing keyboard flow tomorrow AM.

anna: I’ll put together the aria snippets and sample SR text.

maya: perfect — looping back after changes. :sparkles:
